* feat(docs): rich-explore runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.s6s)

main.ts is the card's entry and browses fixture.ts's in-memory files;
node.ts, which npm run demo runs, browses the real file system. Every
import is by published name, and the shared FileSystem type is imported
from its own file so the card shows no unused capability tabs.

Escape no longer quits: in the card it is the first half of the way out
(Escape then Tab), so it ended the program on the way. q and Ctrl-C quit.

* fix(docs): rich-explore review — Escape test can fail, card says when it quits, stale comments (rich-demos-k78j.s6s)
